title: Hedgehog dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe9a8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='45' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- motion lines -->
  <path d='M12 40 Q6 46 12 52' stroke='#ffcf4d' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 34 Q94 40 88 46' stroke='#ffcf4d' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 22 Q26 16 32 20' stroke='#7fe3ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M40 78 Q34 84 30 90' stroke='#c97a3a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 78 Q66 84 70 90' stroke='#c97a3a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a4d22'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a4d22'/>
  <!-- arms up dancing -->
  <path d='M34 58 Q24 50 20 40' stroke='#c97a3a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 58 Q76 50 80 40' stroke='#c97a3a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#e8a35c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#f7d9a8'/>
  <!-- spines -->
  <g fill='#7a4a9a'>
    <path d='M30 52 L22 40 L36 46 Z'/>
    <path d='M40 46 L36 30 L48 42 Z'/>
    <path d='M52 44 L52 26 L60 42 Z'/>
    <path d='M64 46 L70 32 L72 46 Z'/>
    <path d='M74 52 L84 44 L80 56 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#a678d0'>
    <path d='M35 50 L30 38 L42 46 Z'/>
    <path d='M46 42 L44 30 L54 42 Z'/>
    <path d='M58 42 L64 30 L66 44 Z'/>
    <path d='M70 50 L78 42 L78 54 Z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='15' fill='#e8a35c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#f7d9a8'/>
  <!-- eyes happy -->
  <path d='M43 42 Q45 38 47 42' stroke='#5a2d0c' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 42 Q55 38 57 42' stroke='#5a2d0c' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='49' r='3' fill='#4a2410'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 53 Q50 57 55 53' stroke='#5a2d0c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
</svg>
